Messages.Author: Barontinel

Ooops, Sorry about that.

Independent: If Reg performs a successful equip action, you may move the equipment to any ready minion you control. +1 bleed.

So, my question again:

If Reg gets more than 1 equpment fron another vampire and wants to transfer it to another minion, does he have to tranfer it all? or is it posissible to tranfer only part of it?

Messages.Author: Joscha
Messages.Body:
IANPB but as it is a 'may' I'd say you could transfer as much as you want to.

Baron of Frankfurt

Messages.Author: Haze
Messages.Body:
You may move all the equipment he gets to just one minion. It's all or nothing, you can't split them up.

Now just another thing about timing.

When does Reg passees the equipment through his text?

a/ Just after taking the equip action

Messages.Author: Juggernaut1981
Messages.Body:
Neither.

As soon as Reg would equip with the cards they instead go to another minion. He doesn't get the chance to use the equipment, but he will trigger any secondary effects such as an untap from Leather Jacket.

Retired Baron of Sydney, Australia, 418

Messages.Body:
